summary:
F1: Phishing email from docusign-aegean-share.com (subject: Satın alma sözleşmesi – imza bekliyor) delivered to z.korkmaz@aegean.edu {T1566.002}.
F3: Suspected session-token replay via zero-MFA sign-in from OVH SAS (AS16276) without a managed device while the user is concurrently active on dev-zk-01 {T1550.004,T1078.004}.
F4: Duplicate session-token replay signal from OVH SAS (AS16276) with no device concurrent to managed-device activity on dev-zk-01 {T1550.004,T1078.004}.
F2: Impossible travel from Amsterdam to Gravelines in 15 minutes {T1078.004}.

Quarantine the phishing message from docusign-aegean-share.com, block sender/domain, and search other mailboxes for delivery.
Correlate OVH SAS (AS16276) sign-ins with endpoint telemetry on dev-zk-01 to confirm credential reuse or lateral movement.

contrastive.explanation: Removing F3, F4 would drop the chain below the "≥2 confirmed abuse OR 1 abuse + 2 access" threshold, so the policy would escalate for human review.

risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing lure delivered (F1) followed by zero-MFA session-token replay from OVH SAS cloud infrastructure while the user is concurrently active on the managed university device (F3, F4), corroborated by impossible travel Amsterdam→Gravelines (OVH location) in 15 minutes (F2). The rejected password-spray claim is explained away as shared-egress background noise and does not weaken the takeover evidence.
